description: Codex: Orks (11e) INFESTED WAR ZONE (Runt Swarm, 2 CP, either player's turn, any phase) in the ENEMY's Shooting phase through the real enemy_unit_has_attacked window (design §3) and the new_reserve_unit follow-up (§3.2). Fixture ork11e_orks_reactive: P1 Custodes active, P2 Orks. Setup privileges: P2's detachment is switched to Runt Swarm; Gretchin Alpha (U_GRETCHIN_C) and Custodian Guard F are placed ~11" apart in the open and 9 of the 10 Gretchin are removed; both players have 4 CP. The Custodes shoot the Gretchin with the phase action their AI sends (atomic SHOOT): the last Grot dies, the unit is destroyed, and once Custodian Guard F has attacked the window opens for PLAYER 2 (the owner of the destroyed unit, non-active): the StratagemDialog offers INFESTED WAR ZONE (2 CP) on the destroyed Gretchin unit with an enabled Use button while the hot-seat overlay names Player 2. A real click on Use spends 2 CP and adds a NEW Gretchin unit identical to the destroyed one (fresh id U_GRETCHIN_C_R2, 10 models at full wounds) to Player 2's army in Strategic Reserves; the destroyed unit stays destroyed.
